notes.title: Moi Moi Heroes is Live!
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

Thank you all so much for the support so far! We’re incredibly proud to announce the release of the single player demo for our first project, Moi Moi Heroes.

Now we understand that this is an incredibly limited demo, but this project is meant to be a community effort. This demo comes with a few single layer levels, as well as a feature complete character controller- the building block of the entire project.

Where this project goes within the next 6 months will be entirely up to YOU, the community; which is why we added a link to our official discord in the menu screen of the Demo. 

So please, give it a try, jump in the discord, and tell us where to go with it next. We’re incredibly proud of what we have built, and are beyond excited to begin working with you all!

Thank you again for all of the support- Let’s get to work!
Bryce
